name: zaip-aios-plugin
description: Company memory and local workflows for development, design, marketing, sales, growth, operations and business decisions.

interface.longDescription: Choose one of six teams to start with, or set up all six at your own pace. Selecting teams configures their named ZAIP subagents in your project. Get one-off plans in chat. Keep reusable decisions in the relevant area and choose Word for deliverables that need it. Reconcile existing document pairs when editing them. Use 204 skills and 23 specialist perspectives to plan campaigns, measure growth, develop software and run operations with the connections available in your client.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a team and set up this project for my company.
Check what changed in the sales playbook and reconcile Word and Markdown.

pt-BR.subtitle: Projetos, marketing e métricas
pt-BR.description: Escolha uma das seis equipes para começar ou configure todas no seu ritmo. Escolher as equipes já configura os subagentes delas com os nomes completos do ZAIP neste projeto. Receba planos pontuais no chat. Guarde decisões reutilizáveis na fonte da área e use Word quando o entregável pedir. Concilie os formatos ao editar um par existente. Use 204 skills e a perspectiva de 23 especialistas para conduzir campanhas, medir growth, desenvolver software e organizar operações com as conexões disponíveis no seu cliente.
